description: This file declares the ActiveSessions singleton class responsible for managing OpenCDMSession instances, including creation, retrieval, and removal, within a media DRM context.

classes.name: ActiveSessions
classes.description: Singleton class managing active OpenCDMSession instances, providing methods to create, retrieve, and remove sessions.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ActiveSessions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new OpenCDMSession with specified parameters and adds it to active sessions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an existing OpenCDMSession by key ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified OpenCDMSession from active sessions.
